chartSubtitle: This chart shows how your recovery might progress over time. It is illustrative, not a measurement of your health.
chartEmpty: No recovery curves to show on this chart yet.
chartCurveNote: Percentages show progress along each illustrative curve, not how much your body has recovered.
legendYearHint: Orientative values at the model’s day 365.
legendTodayHintLive: Orientative advance with the days elapsed since the recorded date.
legendTodayHintDemo: Demonstration values. They do not use your account data.
chartCaptionLive: Estimated Soma catalog trajectory. Does not equal a clinical measurement. The Today column is curve progress with elapsed days; the 365 days column is the day-365 model checkpoint.
chartCaptionDemo: Demonstration values, not measurements. Each row is a mockup curve. There is no Today column: the demonstration day counts do not share a single clock.
estimateSrLive: Orientative catalog estimate: estimated trajectory advance
liveFootnote: Estimated trajectory from the Soma catalog. “Today” uses real days since the recorded last-use date; the axis marks (1 month to 365 days) are model checkpoints, not a clinical prediction or the end of recovery.
liveFootnoteOverlay: Each substance has a different number of days since last use, so we can't show a single ‘today’ on the chart.
chartCaptionLiveOverlay: Comparative Soma catalog trajectory at model checkpoints. Does not equal a clinical measurement. There is no Today column because abstinence days differ by substance; the 365 days column is the day-365 checkpoint.
demoFootnote: Demonstration values. Each substance has its own day count, so there is no shared “today”. The legend uses each curve’s point at day 365 on the axis.
phaseActive: We do not show an abstinence count while use is still recorded as active.
phaseMissingDate: Add the date of last use to see the time elapsed.
phaseNoCurves: This substance has no trajectory curves in the catalog, so no percentage is shown.
substancePhaseDefault: Estimated trajectory advance from the Soma catalog
substancePhaseCeilingConfidence: Estimated trajectory advance · Model ceiling: {{percent}}% · confidence {{confidence}}
organBodyAbstinent: {{organ}}: estimated trajectory advance {{percent}} after {{days}} without {{substance}}. Does not equal a clinical measurement.
organBodyActive: {{organ}}: use is still recorded as active, so we do not show curve progress for this estimate.
organBodyMixed: Some substances are recorded as active use and others with registered abstinence. We do not show a combined advance.
organEstimatePartial: This estimate only includes substances with a recorded last-use date and a calculable trajectory.
emptyBody: When you register substances in your profile, you will see Soma catalog estimates here.
emptyHint: There are no substances in your profile yet.
liveDescription: See the time since you last recorded each substance, and explore how your body may recover.
demoDescription: Demonstration with example counts. Each substance is shown on its own. Estimates below are educational, not health measurements.
homeDailyMessages: Today it is enough to take the next step.
Being here is already a way of moving forward.
One day at a time. That is the path.
Quiet consistency is also courage.
Today does not need to be perfect. It needs to be yours.
What you choose in silence still counts.
Keep your own pace. The day still counts.
Looking after this day is building the next one.
A small step is still a step.
Not every kind of progress makes a noise.
Some important decisions go unseen.
Direction matters more than speed.
What you repeat today can make tomorrow easier.
Keeping at it is part of the process too.
Some changes begin before you even notice them.
Not everything you feel has to become an action.
You can notice an urge without having to follow it.
Choosing also means giving yourself time to decide.
You do not have to answer every thought.
Your next decision is still in your hands.
Saying no can also be a way of looking after yourself.
You can change direction without denying your past.
Not every habit deserves to follow you into the future.
Reclaiming space to choose is progress too.
A hard day does not erase the days you have already built.
Being tired does not mean you are going backwards.
Today you may need more patience than yesterday.
A stumble does not have to decide the next step.
Some days, looking after yourself means slowing down.
You do not need to feel well to treat yourself with respect.
Feelings change, even when they seem to stay.
Do not turn a bad moment into a verdict on who you are.
You can start again without waiting for Monday.
Small routines can hold up important changes.
Rest also deserves a place in your plans.
Your surroundings can make your decisions easier.
You do not need to change everything at once.
Every new habit needs room to grow.
Preparing for a hard moment is a way of looking after yourself too.
A simple routine can be a solid foothold.
Trying again is part of learning.
The everyday can become an achievement too.
Your story includes what you have lived, and also what you choose to build.
You are not only the sum of your hardest days.
There are parts of you that you are still discovering.
The future does not need to look like the past.
You can build a life that does not revolve around use.
You do not need to prove your change to everyone.
Your interests deserve space again too.
Getting time back for yourself opens new possibilities.
You do not have to know exactly who you will be tomorrow.
There are many ways of finding yourself again.
You do not need to sort out your whole life to look after this moment.
An honest conversation can change the tone of a day.
It is also all right to ask for company.
There are quiet moments that deserve to be remembered.
Paying attention to simple things has value too.
You can be grateful for something without denying what worries you.
Sharing a difficulty can make it less lonely.
Today there is also room for something you enjoy.
